purpose: Make approved original LuHm art and visual semantics the default from first paint, while providing four server-enforced remote session-risk tiers and a separately persistent trusted-local-device experience.

visualLaw.assetCanon: Original approved character masters remain immutable references; responsive derived variants must preserve identity and carry source hashes/licensing/approval status.
visualLaw.petPresentation: Reuse existing pet dock and actual loading sprite manifest; pet messages are UI, never fabricated independent-agent thoughts or proof.
visualLaw.fallback: Small accessible inline LuHmOS vector monogram when approved character art is unavailable, not an invented final character design.
visualLaw.statusTruth: A mascot may animate during actual loading, but PASS or percentages require independently verified evidence.

surfaces.owner: LuHm HTML and responsive app shell
surfaces.contract: Fast inline vector/monogram, branded title, CSS, window borders, colors and icons before any remote asset loads.
Deliver branded lightweight preflight UI and loading status where hosting allows; provider-owned Render cold-start screen is not replaceable by service CSS.

surfaces.owner: LuHm Godot project and exported web shell
surfaces.contract: Set project boot splash color/image and custom web HTML loading screen; export image format must meet engine requirements; reuse approved brand assets.
Show pet/loading and branded controls within installed plugin resource; native ChatGPT thinking indicator, host controls and first-party UI are outside plugin's authority.

styling.chrome: Winamp-inspired compact skins on owned surfaces
styling.icons: SVG first with high-contrast reduced-motion fallback
styling.characterArt: Final approved render/Live2D only after manifest approval, integrity and rights validation
styling.copyright: Record provenance and approvals, do not assume ownership of external copyrighted designs.

visualLaw.availability: Do not block first paint on Render warmup, CDN, Cloudflare, Godot loading or model inference. Do not show fake percentage progress.

sessionLaw.reference: NIST SP 800-63B-4 reauthentication and OWASP Session Management Cheat Sheet are guidance, not automatic regulatory certification. Values below are LuHm proposals.
sessionLaw.cloudflareAccess: Global/application session duration between 15 minutes and one month, default 24 hours; app/front-door token and application session are separate.
sessionLaw.passwordRotation: Change if compromised, user-requested, or required by explicit external policy; favor rotating short-lived access and refresh tokens with revocation.

fourRemoteTiers.label: Public low-risk member
fourRemoteTiers.auth: Ordinary authenticated access, optional stronger sign-in
fourRemoteTiers.scope: public account and low-risk personalization only
fourRemoteTiers.accessPolicy: Cloudflare Access may use up to one month if explicitly configured; never assume default changed.

fourRemoteTiers.label: Private workspace / approved collaborator
fourRemoteTiers.auth: MFA on private sign-in, device recognition does not replace authorization
fourRemoteTiers.scope: private files and collaboration; writes still require scoped policy.

fourRemoteTiers.label: Remote operational controls
fourRemoteTiers.auth: MFA and scoped roles; step-up for significant state changes
fourRemoteTiers.scope: server configuration, reviewed source mutation and deployment candidates.

fourRemoteTiers.label: Crown / signing / security / public publishing
fourRemoteTiers.auth: Fresh phishing-resistant authentication and explicit action approval, owner-only authority
fourRemoteTiers.scope: signing, DNS/certs, production promotion, credentials and public release.

indefiniteLocalDeviceTrust.userGoal: Open the LuHm UI on one specifically enrolled personal home workstation without repeated provider passwords.
indefiniteLocalDeviceTrust.recommended: OS-protected device-bound credential, hardware-backed key when available, OS screen lock, per-action reauthentication for private remote or crown tasks.
indefiniteLocalDeviceTrust.backupRecovery: Keep owner-managed fallback recovery separate from browser cache.

sessionLaw.escalation: Escalation adds authorization checks and shorter reauthentication windows; prior low-risk session never automatically becomes owner-level permission.
sessionLaw.providerConstraint: Actual Cloudflare Access, OpenAI/ChatGPT and other vendor-controlled sessions retain their own enforceable limits; LuHm controls only sessions it owns.
